categories.title: Checkpoint
categories.info: Points you can Teeleport to directly, so long as you're already in this Layer as a whole. A few are also Transition points.

categories.title: Chip Exchange
categories.info:
Exchange Banadium Chips for Banandium Gems, starting at 10 Chips and increasing by 10 for every purchase.

Note that the first Gem purchased on each layer is the only one that will count towards your collection.

categories.title: Getaway
categories.info: Speak to the Architectone to exchange gold for a getaway. Each one comes with a bed to restore health, closet for changing clothes, and gramophone to play music discs.

categories.title: Rehearsal Hall
categories.info: Rehearsal Halls are large-scale challenges that focus on a specific Bananza form. They can only be accessed after finishing the story.

categories.title: Style Shop
categories.info: Style Shops let you buy and upgrade cosmetic items using the local Fossils in that layer.

categories.title: Banandium Gem
categories.info: Collecting 5 Banandium Gems allow you to upgrade DK's abilities through Skill Points.

categories.title: Clothing
categories.info: Clothing can be purchased (and sometimes upgraded) at Style Shops for fossils. They grant a wide variety of gameplay benefits.

categories.title: Extra-Rare Fossil
categories.info: Extra-Rare Fossils are used for the final upgrade of the showpiece Style Shop items.

categories.title: Fossil
categories.info: Common Fossils are used to buy the lowest-grade cosmetics at Style Shops, as well as buy their first upgrade.

categories.title: Rare Fossil
categories.info: Rare Fossils are used to buy and upgrade showpiece Style Shop items, as well as buy the final upgrade of more common items.

categories.title: Shifty Smash
categories.info: Shifty Smash Challenges begin by punching the triangular pyramid, which will spawn one or several Shifty Blocks in the area. Destroy them all within the time limit to complete the challenge.

locations.title: Entry to the Heart of Gold
Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Associated Banandium Gem:** [07 - Planet Core Chip Exchange](#loc=496576)

locations.title: Final Rehearsal - Great Harmoneel's Windpipe
locations.description:
**Location:** In the middle of the Heart of Gold after completing all other rehearsal halls.

**Reward:** 
- [22 - Halfway through the Harmoneel](#loc=496628)
- [23 - End of the Harmoneel](#loc=496629)

locations.title: 01 - Victory over Void Kong!
locations.description: **Location:** In front of you when landing in this layer.

locations.title: 02 - A View of the King
locations.description: **Location:** On top of a tower on the island. Use Ostrich Bananza or Turf Surf over the spikes to reach it.

locations.title: 03 - In the Belly of K. Rool
locations.description: **Location:** Inside the belly of the K. Rool statue.

locations.title: 04 - Floating over Fractone Fort
locations.description: **Location:** On a floating island, reached by throwing a chunk of terrain at the Shifty Stone above the shops then using Snake Bananza to jump into a barrel cannon.

locations.title: 05 - Shifty Smash: Inhale and Destroy
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=496549)

locations.title: 06 - Planet Core Smashin' Stats
locations.description: **Location:** Given to you by Smashintone after smashing through 70,000 cubic metres of gold in this layer.

locations.title: 07 - Planet Core Chip Exchange
locations.description: **Location:** Exchanged for Banandium Chips at the [Chip Exchange](#loc=496350).

locations.title: 08 - Survived the Gravel Gauntlet
locations.description: **Location:** Found at the end of the self-building path.

locations.title: 09 - Klaptrapped behind the Goo
locations.description: **Location:** At the end of the first two goo bridges.

locations.title: 10 - The Switcheroo Chase
locations.description: **Location:** Next to the minecart.

locations.title: 11 - Korner of the Krevasse
locations.description: **Location:** Directly left of the final Dive Punch arrow. Use Ostrich Bananza to reach it safely.

locations.title: 12 - Cracking Open the Way
locations.description: **Location:** In front of the minecart.

locations.title: 14 - Stomped Stompenclomper! Again!
locations.description: **Location:** Next to the minecart.

locations.title: 13 - The Kremling Krew's Last Stand
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for defeating multiple waves of enemies.

locations.title: 15 - Planet Core Quiz Master
locations.description:
**Location:** Given to you by Quiztone, found on the lower platform.
- Which of these curiously absent animals do NOT have Fractone imitators?
  - Seal
- According to Poppy, VoidCo is the most ____ mining operation on the planet.
  - Powerful
- Think fast... what is OUR name?
  - Quiztone

locations.title: 16 - Shifty Smash: Skyward Smashing
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for completing the [Shifty Smash Challenge](#loc=496602)

locations.title: 17 - Fractone Cradle Climb
locations.description: **Location:** On top of a block looming over the pit. Use Snake Bananza charged jumps to reach it.

locations.title: 18 - Turf Surf Pit Stop
locations.description: **Location:** On top of a thorny tower. To reach it, dismount on a nearby metal circle and jump into the air with Snake Bananza, then fly over with Ostrich Bananza.

locations.title: 19 - Turf Surf Finish Line
locations.description: **Location:** In front of the minecart.

locations.title: 20 - Cranky's Planet Core Rant
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for listening to [Cranky Kong](#loc=496622)'s rambling.

locations.title: 21 - Rocked King K. Rool!
locations.description: **Location:** Reward for defeating King K. Rool.

locations.title: 22 - Halfway through the Harmoneel
locations.description: **Location:** Halfway through the [Final Rehearsal](#loc=496626).

locations.title: 23 - End of the Harmoneel
locations.description: **Location:** At the very end of the [Final Rehearsal](#loc=496626).

locations.title: Golden Britches
locations.description:
**Effect:** Reduces damage from thorns, spikes, and Banandium Mush by 10 percent.

**Cost:** 1 8-Bit Barrel

locations.title: Girded Britches
locations.description:
**Effect:** Reduces damage from thorns, spikes, and Banandium Mush by 20 percent.

**Cost:** 3 8-Bit Barrel

**Upgrades:**
- Increase to 30 percent: 5 Barrels
- Increase to 40 percent: 3 8-Bit Items

locations.title: Soggy Cravat
locations.description:
**Effect:** Fiery rain won't burn you, and lava will be cooled.

**Cost:** 1 8-Bit Item

**Upgrades:**
- Lava will be cooled within a 100 percent larger radius: 3 8-Bit Items
- Lava will be cooled within a 150 percent larger radius: 1 8-Bit DK

locations.title: Lady's Dress
locations.description:
**Effect:** Extends all of your Bananza times by 20 percent.

**Cost:** 3 8-Bit Barrels

**Upgrades:**
- Increase to 40 percent: 5 Barrels
- Increase to 60 percent: 3 8-Bit Items

locations.title: Arcade Dress
locations.description:
**Effect:** Copies the effect (and upgrades) of the [Lady's Dress](#loc=496533)

**Cost:** 2 8-Bit Barrels

locations.description:

**Strategy:** Use Snake Bananza, grab a chunk of terrain, then charge jump to reach the shifty blocks and repeat. 

**Reward:** [16 - Shifty Smash: Skyward Smashing](#loc=496609)
